en: Black-and-white postcard showing a grand historic city hall square. A tall clock/bell tower with a baroque dome rises above an ornate, multi-storey building with mansard-style roofs and rich decoration. In front of it stands a baroque plague column with statues and a star-topped cross, plus a statue on a pedestal and terraced steps leading down into the square. Surrounding the square are classical townhouses and another church-like building with a tower in the distance. The reverse side has handwritten Hungarian text, printed location information, and a Hungarian stamp.
